english.title: Tattoo person under 18 for reason other than medical
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), other than for medical reasons, did tattoo **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person under the age of 18 years
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 1 and 2 of the Tattooing of Minors Act 1969.

english.notes:
(i) If the tattoo is performed for medical reasons it must be done by a duly qualified medical practitioner or by a person working under his direction.
(ii) It is a defence if the defendant believed and had had reasonable cause to believe that the person tattooed was of or over the age of 18 years.
(iii) For the purposes of this Act a 'tattoo' shall mean the insertion into the skin of any colouring material designed to leave a permanent mark (Section 3).
